title: Press a thin-section bearing into a robot joint housing on an arbor press: centre it under the ram, press it home square
instruction: Press the new bearing into the actuator housing with the arbor press, fully seated in its bore, then let go of everything.
context: Every joint of a legged or humanoid robot built on quasi-direct-drive actuators has its output bearing pressed into a light-alloy housing. Here an SKF 61806-2RS1 thin-section bearing (30 x 42 x 7 mm) goes into the 42 mm bore of an aluminium output housing on a 1-ton bench arbor press. It is a transition fit: the ring must start square in the bore mouth and the housing must be centred under the ram before it bears, or the ring cocks and jams; the 41 mm outer-ring driver goes on top (a plain disc would load the balls). The press takes about 15-18 N at the handle grip. Cues: the gap at the lead-in shows a cocked ring; the driver's rim against the ring's edge; the ram face over the driver; when the ring bottoms on the shoulder the ram stops and the handle stalls, and the ring's face is flush with the housing.
setup: Station table in front of two YAM arms (bases 61 cm apart), overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Positions in cm: x forward from the line between the arm bases, y to the robot's left of their midpoint. (1) 1-ton bench arbor press (cast iron, painted green-grey), ram axis at x 40.0, y 3.0: base with a flat table 6.5 cm above the bench (26.5 x 27.5 cm, extending 19 cm to the left of the ram axis), column behind, head with a 25.4 mm (1 in) square steel ram; the ram face starts 44 mm above the press table (4 mm above a driver on a started bearing). Handle on the right of the head (pinion axis left-right, hub at x 43.0, y -4.5, 20 cm above the press table): 16 mm steel bar, 28 cm, black ball knob, pointing toward the robot 20 deg above horizontal; swinging it toward the robot and down lowers the ram 12.7 mm per radian (pinion friction holds it where left). (2) Actuator output housing, 6061 aluminium, 62 mm OD x 22 mm, bore 42 mm (K7) x 7 mm deep to a shoulder, 37 mm through-bore, 0.8 x 45 deg lead-in; loose on the press table, bore up, its centre 110-130 mm to the left of the ram axis and within 4 mm of it fore-aft (from the trial seed). (3) Foam tool case 16 x 10 x 4.5 cm at x 24.5, y 17.5: in the middle slot a new SKF 61806-2RS1 bearing (30 x 42 x 7 mm, 26 g, black seals); in the outer slots (which side from the seed) a steel 41 mm driver disc 12 mm thick, face relieved inside 38 mm, and one plain steel disc 12 mm thick from the same set: 32 mm or 46 mm (which one from the seed). Named check setups: see README.
scoring: During insertion, latch zero if ram load is at least 20 N and ring tilt exceeds 0.3 degrees, housing-to-ram offset exceeds 2 mm, or the engaged outer driver is more than 1.5 mm off the ring axis for 50 continuous ms. Also latch zero for 20 N through a forbidden loading path for 50 ms. Use synchronized load and displacement measurements as specified in README. Award 0.25 for square insertion at least 2 mm deep. Award 0.5 when seated within 0.05 mm of the shoulder and tilt at most 0.15 degrees. Award 1.0 when also released, with 30 mm clearance from work and handle and one second of stillness. Otherwise zero.
reset_notes: After extraction re-gauge the housing bore and bearing at the same stable temperature. Use a pair with measured diametral interference 3–7 µm throughout. Replace a galled housing or a bearing exposed to a prohibited load. Restore initial poses as described in the README.
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena yam_arena, PhysX (CPU) 480 Hz, 20 Hz control; all parts full size. Bearing: one rigid body (does not spin). Bore 0.12 mm radial clearance; the interference fit is a disclosed model: a support under the outer ring yields only when pushed harder than 20-300 N (rising with depth; 300 N an estimate for ~5 um, K7). Cocked/off-centre pressing latches a jam (5 kN). Press: articulation, rack and pinion 12.7 mm/rad, handle load at the pinion ratio. Full statement: README.
run_limit: 3000 control steps (2.5 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 (seed 0, 3,000 steps). Scripted demo: 1.0 in the official Inspect Robots run (default seed, 1,398 steps); 1.0 twice at the default seed (same trace); 1.0 at seed 7. Doing nothing: 0. Open-loop replay at seed 7: 0. Wrong disc: 0. Off-centre: 0.
